items.desc: Microsoft library for ASCII/Unicode diagrams: draws graphs and charts right in the terminal.

items.desc: Open-source low-code for internal tools: drag-and-drop UI on top of DBs/APIs, 50+ integrations, JS extensions. Can be self-hosted.

items.desc: Google UI framework for cross-platform apps (iOS/Android/web/desktop) with a single codebase in Dart, hot reload and a rich set of widgets.
